meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Processes and analyzes data with resident-kernel engines (DuckDB, Polars) and one-shot tools. Use for CSV/parquet/JSON analysis, group-by/join/aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, or plotting a dataset.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地数据文件,快速获得统计汇总与图表。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要处理表格或 CSV 等数据文件,想快速做统计和示意图。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local data files and quickly produce statistical summaries and charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with spreadsheets or CSV data and want quick summaries and charts.

howto.what: Claude 会用 DuckDB、Polars、numpy 在常驻内核里直接查询 CSV、Parquet、JSON,做分组、连接、聚合、时间序列和清洗,并按需画图。它先决定计算放在内存、流式还是远程,再给出答案,重活会报告行数与耗时。
howto.when: 当你要求分析 CSV、Parquet、JSON 数据集,做分组聚合或画图等数据问题时接管;没有内核或 REPL 环境时改走 CLI 脚本。

say.text: 分析这份 sales.csv,按月汇总销售额并报告耗时

say.text: 把 data.parquet 按地区求均值,再画个分布图
say.note: 画图前按可视化参考执行质检

say.text: 合并 orders.json 和 users.csv,找出没下过单的用户

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes CSV, Parquet, and JSON with DuckDB, Polars, and numpy in a resident kernel: joins, aggregation, time series, cleaning, charts. It decides where the computation runs first, then reports row counts and timing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for analysis of a CSV, Parquet, or JSON dataset, group-by/aggregation, or a chart; with no kernel or REPL it falls back to a CLI script.
